comment: Keys, values, messages and numbers of the Core 2 enemy package (WP-11, docs/design/11): the enemy's move preview, delayed moves, the reaction moves and their stack entries, the intent read, what the player predicts and the knowledge ledger.

keySets.name: Core2EnemyKeys
keySets.doc: Keys the enemy package reads and writes: the move preview, the committed plan of an enemy's reaction, the knowledge feedback and the ledger.

keys.AppliedXp: run enemy Perception receipts require valid identity and XP
keys.CurrentEncounter: run current enemy learning encounter is invalid
keys.EncounterIdLength: Enemy encounter receipt is too long
keys.EncounterRequired: Enemy learning requires an accepted encounter and enemy definition IDs
keys.LedgerBounds: enemyKnowledge.{0} has an empty or unbounded encounter ledger
keys.LedgerReceipt: enemyKnowledge.{0} has an invalid encounter receipt
keys.LedgerRow: enemyKnowledge.{0} requires a known enemy, mastery target 20–50 and encounter receipts
keys.LedgerShape: enemyKnowledge requires version 1 and an enemy ledger
keys.PerEnemyTarget: enemyKnowledge.bestiary.perEnemy.{0} requires a known enemy and mastery target 20–50
keys.PerceptionCosts: enemyKnowledge.perception level costs exceed the safe integer range
keys.PerceptionCurve: enemyKnowledge.perception requires a finite positive XP curve, maximum level 1–50 and integer award
keys.PerceptionOverflow: Perception XP exceeds the safe integer range
keys.PerceptionRow: Perception requires valid XP, level and zero pending drafts
keys.PerceptionUnclaimed: Perception has an unclaimed automatic level
keys.ReadCoefficient: enemyKnowledge.reads.{0} must be a probability coefficient from 0 to 1
keys.ReceiptRequired: Enemy learning requires a caller-owned unique run receipt
keys.ReconcileIdentity: Perception reconciliation requires saved encounter identity and whole earned XP
keys.RecoveryLedger: Enemy knowledge recovery targets require a bounded definition ledger
keys.RecoveryTarget: Enemy knowledge recovery target requires its retained pending ledger
keys.RulesShape: enemyKnowledge rules require version 1, reads, Perception and bestiary pacing
keys.VisitOverflow: Enemy encounter visit exceeds the safe integer range

numberSets.name: Core2EnemyNumbers
numberSets.doc: Numbers of the enemy package: the knowledge ledger bounds and the stage shares.
